title: Made by Matt lesson catalogue

type.description: Record type. 'Lesson', 'Hub' and 'hub' are legacy spellings already carried by 105 rows (UX2 A1, 2026-09-08); new rows use the lower-case forms.

keywords.description: Search keywords. Absent on 88 legacy rows that carry description/thumbnail instead (measured 2026-09-08); required on new rows by the UX2 catalogue tools. uniqueItems is not asserted: 8 reviewed shelf rows (743-750) repeat a keyword and are digest-locked.

year.description: Academic year the resource belongs to

description.description: Legacy alias of desc on 88 rows; new rows use desc.

thumbnail.description: Legacy thumbnail path on 88 rows; new rows use thumb.

halfTerm.description: UX2 A1 (2026-09-08): the half-term the lesson resolves to, from the lesson's own declaration or a scheme-of-work cell; labels are the spine's (_sownb/TERM_DATES.md). Never derived from a filename. Written only by tools/ux2/unit_tags.py.

unit.description: UX2 A1 (2026-09-08): the unit the lesson belongs to, only when its own metadata, its pack index / START_HERE, or a scheme-of-work row naming the same title states one. Written only by tools/ux2/unit_tags.py.

kind.description: UX2 D3 (2026-09-08): record kind for non-lesson entries. 'pack' = a companion pack (editable slides and documents) for one deployed lesson; the pack's HTML is never deployed. Written only by tools/ux2/companion_catalogue.py.

companionOf.description: UX2 D3: the deployed lesson this pack was matched to (D1: sha256, exact title, or normalised filename), as a catalogue-relative path. The lesson is canonical; the pack never edits it.

builtFrom.description: UX2 D3: sha256 of the pack's own source HTML, recorded when the deployed lesson was matched by title or filename rather than by digest.

packRevisionDrift.description: UX2 D3: true when the pack HTML and the deployed lesson differ in title, learning-objective line or stage minutes (D1 DRIFT check). Teacher-facing only: 'Built from an earlier revision of this lesson.'

files.description: UX2 D3: the pack's landed files, one entry each; role and type are the closed sets the order names. Held files (D2) are not listed.

description: Made by Matt lesson catalogue. Enforced by tools/ux2/check_catalogue_schema.py (UX2 A1); additionalProperties is false, so a new key needs a schema change first. UX2 D3 (2026-09-08) added kind, companionOf, builtFrom, packRevisionDrift and files for companion-pack entries.
